top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 is a complete, independently confirmed discovery chain with mature outcome-trial evidence, so an award is warranted. A Physiology or Medicine prize should honour the discovery side, namely native hormone physiology, receptor and gut-pancreas biology, and identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide. That gives Drucker, Holst and Mojsov, with the citation stating the therapeutic consequence. Mojsov's priority is contested and unverifiable from the record, so P002 (Knudsen in her place) is a close second, and no award is clearly worst.
